sections.text:
1 Hic codex 335 partim cum Marciano 334 [= 6], partim cum Parisino 2506,
saec. XIII, conspirat. Capita communia saltem ex collectaneis hausta esse viden-
tur quae sibi composuit astrologus quidam Constantinopolitanus (ριξ' : ἡμεῖς
δὲ ἐν Βυζαντίῳ... cf. Paris., f. 126r, τκθ': Περίοδος τῶν ζῳδίων τοῦ διὰ Βυζαν-
τίου κλίματος) qui saeculo XI florebat (f. 170v, c. σλ', legitur καταρχή anni ͵ςφι'
ἰνδικτιῶνος ιε' [= 1002 p. C.]; f. 194, c. τ' [editum] ἔτους ͵ςφογ' [= 1065 p. C.] ;
cf. Parisin., f. 129r, c. τλε': ἔτους ͵σφδ' [= 997 p. C. n.]; adde quod f. 189v, c. σπα',
Leo Sapiens [886-911 p. C.] auctor citatur). F. C.
sections.en:
1 This codex 335 partly with Marcianus 334 [= 6], partly with Parisinus 2506,
of the 13th century, agrees. The common chapters at least seem to have been drawn from collections
which a certain Constantinopolitan astrologer compiled for himself (117: ἡμεῖς ('we')
δὲ ('but') ἐν ('in') Βυζαντίῳ... ('Byzantium...') cf. Paris., f. 126r, 329: Περίοδος ('Period') τῶν ('of the') ζῳδίων ('zodiac signs') τοῦ ('of the') διὰ ('through') Βυζαν- ('Byzan-')
τίου ('-tium') κλίματος ('climate')) who flourished in the 11th century (f. 170v, c. 230, is read καταρχή ('inception') of the year 6510
of the 15th indiction [= 1002 A.D.]; f. 194, c. 300 [edited] ἔτους ('of the year') ͵ςφογ' ('6573') [= 1065 A.D.];
cf. Parisin., f. 129r, c. 335: ἔτους ('of the year') ͵σφδ' ('6504') [= 997 A.D.]; add that on f. 189v, c. 281,
Leo the Wise [886-911 A.D.] is cited as author). [F. C.]

summary.headline: Marcianus 335 manuscript catalog
summary.text: Continuation of chapter listings on planetary terms, zodiacal ascensions, inceptions from Manetho’s Apotelesmatika, and ruling outcomes, followed by the catalog entry for Marcianus 335, a fifteenth-century manuscript with astrological diagrams, agricultural astrology, lunar configurations, and a chapter index.
